description: RESERVATION-DESIGN.md §2 (farms): the invitation a farm owner wallet signs for one node, as EIP-712 typed data under the reservation broker's domain; the node presents farm, expiresAt and the signature to joinFarm, which recovers the owner and admits the node; membership has no expiry (leaveFarm, removeFromFarm or a join to another farm end it), the invitation is refused after expiresAt and after the one joinFarm it served. The configuration string is what the node agent reads from <NETWORK>_FARM_INVITE.
domainNote: name and version are the broker's constants; chainId and verifyingContract are the deployment's (test values here); a verifier rebuilds the domain from the broker it talks to, never from this file

rules.binding: farm must equal the recovered signer, or, when farm has code, farm.isValidSignature(digest, signature) must return 0x1626ba7e (EIP-1271; the owner wallet is the farm either way); node must equal msg.sender of joinFarm; block.timestamp must be at most expiresAt; the domain binds the invitation to one broker and one chain; the digest is recorded at joinFarm and refused again (one join per invitation; a fresh one carries another expiresAt)
rules.membership: a node is of one farm at most: joinFarm on another farm leaves the first; leaveFarm by the node and removeFromFarm by the owner clear it; a node that left returns on a fresh invitation only, its earlier one being used
rules.configString: <farm>:<expiresAt>:<signature>, the farm lower-case hex with 0x, expiresAt decimal unix seconds, the signature 65 bytes 0x hex (r, s, v)
